base.$description: Theme-independent tokens, converted from Claude Design system Tallyline, version 1791542897-a5d3; lengths are px at the 14 px base.

display-name.$description: The system and app name on the cover and the About dialog only.

heading-3.$description: Group titles inside panels and settings sections.

label-caps.$description: Short labels written as literal capitals (TERMINAL, SIDE, MODE). No tracking.

body.$description: Default UI and body text. The 100 % base size.

body-strong.$description: Emphasised values in prose, counters' words, selected navigation.

caption.$description: Hints under fields, the key hint, column captions. Smallest text in the system.

chip.$description: State chips, source chips, environment chip.

table-name.$description: Commodity names in rows. Never smaller than the base.

table-text.$description: Text cells (status names) and the State column.

table-meta.$description: Ages and sources beside values ("3 days ago").

numerals.$description: Every price, SCU, UEX value, Δ figure, count and time in tables and headers.

numerals-strong.$description: Counters and the value in a focused or confirmed cell.

mono-log.$description: Log viewer, file paths, hosts in diagnostics.

space-4.$description: Gap between an icon and its label; badge padding.

space-6.$description: Gap between chips in a row.

space-8.$description: Compact cell padding; control inner padding.

space-12.$description: Panel padding (compact); gap between toolbar groups.

space-24.$description: Gap between counter groups; section spacing in settings.

space-cell-pad-x-compact.$description: Horizontal cell padding at compact density.

space-cell-pad-x-comfortable.$description: Horizontal cell padding at comfortable density (default).

radius-0.$description: Table cells, in-table inputs, crop thumbnails: never rounded or chamfered.

width-state.$description: Borders that carry a state (confidence borders, test indicator).

width-focus-gap.$description: Gap between a state border and the focus ring inside it, filled with the cell's background.

width-frame-accent.$description: Top edge of the single focal panel.

width-selection-mark.$description: Selection bar in the row's leading slot.

size-row-comfortable.$description: Row height at comfortable density (default, D8).

size-control.$description: Buttons, fields and comboboxes outside tables.

size-control-small.$description: Toolbar icon buttons, chips; minimum target.

size-in-cell-control.$description: Controls inside table cells (confirmation control, Keep mine / Take new). Never smaller.

size-icon-sm.$description: Icons in cells, chips and badges.

size-icon-md.$description: Icons in buttons, the top bar and navigation.

size-sidebar.$description: Expanded sidebar and the rail overlay.

size-crop-thumb-compact.$description: Retired 2026-10-09, not used: crop thumbnail height at compact density.

size-crop-thumb-comfortable.$description: Retired 2026-10-09, not used: crop thumbnail height at comfortable density.

size-window-min-width.$description: Minimum window width (proposed); reference for the 200 % text check.

size-fankit-logo.$description: Square placeholder frame of the Fan Kit logo. Provisional; the kit's minimum size is unverified.

motion.$description: From the system README, section Motion; the system's tokens.json has no motion family.

dark.$description: Colour and shadow tokens of the dark theme, converted from Claude Design system Tallyline, version 1791542897-a5d3.

neutral-50.$description: Primitive. Lightest neutral; used only through aliases.

neutral-900.$description: Primitive. Deepest slate neutral; used only through aliases.

sky-300.$description: Primitive. Accent hue in its light form; used only through aliases.

sky-700.$description: Primitive. Accent hue in its dark form; used only through aliases.

teal-300.$description: Primitive. Success hue (bluish green), light form; used only through aliases.

teal-700.$description: Primitive. Success hue, dark form; used only through aliases.

yellow-300.$description: Primitive. Minor-deviation hue, light form; used only through aliases.

yellow-700.$description: Primitive. Minor-deviation hue, dark form; used only through aliases.

amber-300.$description: Primitive. Caution hue, light form; used only through aliases.

amber-700.$description: Primitive. Caution hue, dark form; used only through aliases.

orange-300.$description: Primitive. Major-deviation hue, light form; used only through aliases.

orange-700.$description: Primitive. Major-deviation hue, dark form; used only through aliases.

red-300.$description: Primitive. Critical hue, light form; used only through aliases.

red-700.$description: Primitive. Critical hue, dark form; used only through aliases.

violet-300.$description: Primitive. Test-mode hue, light form; used only through aliases.

violet-700.$description: Primitive. Test-mode hue, dark form; used only through aliases.

surface-0.$description: Window ground behind every pane. Elevation steps up by lightness: surface-0, surface-1, surface-2, surface-3.

surface-1.$description: Panes, top bar, status bar, sidebar, context header.

surface-2.$description: Raised panels: summary header, cards, table column headers.

surface-3.$description: Popovers, menus, dialogs, tooltips, combobox lists.

surface-sunken.$description: Table body, inputs, log viewer, licence text.

scrim.$description: Plate behind text and controls over screenshot imagery only. Opaque in high contrast. Dimming an owner window behind a dialog is a proposal, not default.

border-subtle.$description: Decorative hairlines between rows and panes. Never the only boundary of a control.

border-default.$description: Panel and card outlines, column header underline.

border-strong.$description: Control boundaries (inputs, buttons, chips, keycaps): at least 3:1 on the ground the control sits on.

border-frame-accent.$description: The single 2 px top edge of the one focal panel (the summary header). Nowhere else.

text-primary.$description: Body text, values and names on every surface, the selection and hover tints, and every deviation background.

text-secondary.$description: Labels, meta and secondary values on every surface, selection and hover tints, and deviation backgrounds.

text-muted.$description: Unit suffixes (aUEC, SCU), ages, placeholders, column captions on surface-0 to surface-3, surface-sunken and the row tints. Still 4.5:1 (7:1 in high contrast).

text-disabled.$description: Disabled labels only. Exempt from the contrast floor; the disabled reason next to it uses text-secondary.

text-inverse.$description: Text on filled light marks, for example inside a filled chip.

text-on-accent.$description: Text and icons on accent fills (primary button).

text-link.$description: Links on surface-0 to surface-3 and surface-sunken. Underlined on hover and focus.

accent.$description: The one interactive accent: primary action fill, selected navigation, link family. Never a state colour.

accent-subtle-bg.$description: Selected navigation item and toggled ghost button background.

focus-ring.$description: Solid inset focus ring, width-focus-ring wide, inside the focused element; in tables inside the cell. At least 3:1 on every surface, deviation background, selection and hover tint.

focus-ring-on-fill.$description: Inset focus ring on filled controls (primary button, Ready chip actions), where focus-ring would vanish. At least 3:1 on accent, accent-hover and success-bg-strong.

focus-ring-on-critical.$description: Inset focus ring on the danger button (critical-bg-strong). At least 3:1 on it.

selection-row-bg.$description: Tint of the selected row on cells without a deviation background. Deviation backgrounds stay visible.

selection-row-mark.$description: 4 px bar in the selected row's own leading slot.

selection-text-bg.$description: Selected text inside inputs and the log viewer.

row-hover-bg.$description: Tint of the row under the pointer on cells without a deviation background.

row-hover-mark.$description: Optional 2 px hover bar in the leading slot when the row is not selected.

neutral-fg.$description: Neutral tone text and icons on neutral-bg and on surface-0 to surface-3.

neutral-bg.$description: Neutral tone background for chips, banners and notices.

neutral-border.$description: Neutral tone border of chips and banners (3:1 on the ground).

info-fg.$description: Info tone text and icons on info-bg and on surface-0 to surface-3.

info-bg.$description: Info tone background for chips, banners and notices.

info-border.$description: Info tone border of chips and banners (3:1 on the ground).

success-fg.$description: Success tone text and icons on success-bg and on surface-0 to surface-3.

success-bg.$description: Success tone background for chips, banners and notices.

success-border.$description: Success tone border of chips and banners (3:1 on the ground).

caution-fg.$description: Caution tone text and icons on caution-bg and on surface-0 to surface-3.

caution-bg.$description: Caution tone background for chips, banners and notices.

caution-border.$description: Caution tone border of chips and banners (3:1 on the ground).

critical-fg.$description: Critical tone text and icons on critical-bg and on surface-0 to surface-3.

critical-bg.$description: Critical tone background for chips, banners and notices.

critical-border.$description: Critical tone border of chips and banners (3:1 on the ground).

critical-bg-strong.$description: Danger button fill and the "Blocked" chip fill; text-primary (dark, high contrast) or #fff-like text-on-critical (light) on it.

confidence-confirm-fg.$description: Icon colour of the confidence-confirm state at the cell's leading edge. Below the send threshold, one candidate.

confidence-confirm-border.$description: 2 px inset cell border of the confidence-confirm state. Never a background.

confidence-select-fg.$description: Icon colour of the confidence-select state at the cell's leading edge. Ambiguous, several candidates.

confidence-select-border.$description: 2 px inset cell border of the confidence-select state. Never a background.

confidence-correct-fg.$description: Icon colour of the confidence-correct state at the cell's leading edge. Unreadable or implausible.

confidence-correct-border.$description: 2 px inset cell border of the confidence-correct state. Never a background.

user-entered-fg.$description: Icon colour of the user-entered state. Typed, corrected or a reference value taken over; no reading confidence.

user-entered-border.$description: 2 px inset cell border of the user-entered state.

confirmed-fg.$description: Icon colour of the confirmed state at the cell's leading edge. Confirmed by the user.

confirmed-border.$description: 2 px inset cell border of the confirmed state. Never a background.

double-confirmed-fg.$description: Icon colour of the double-confirmed state at the cell's leading edge. OCR and AI agree; subtle marker.

double-confirmed-border.$description: 2 px inset cell border of the double-confirmed state. Never a background.

confidence-ok-fg.$description: Optional check mark for ok fields in the detail strip only; ok cells show no mark.

deviation-minor-bg.$description: Cell background of a minor deviation ("please cross-check"). Text on it: text-primary, text-secondary.

deviation-minor-fg.$description: Icon and outlined Δ badge of a minor deviation ("please cross-check"), on deviation-minor-bg and on surface-sunken.

deviation-minor-border.$description: Badge and cell border of a minor deviation ("please cross-check").

deviation-major-bg.$description: Cell background of a major deviation (confirmation required). Text on it: text-primary, text-secondary.

deviation-major-fg.$description: Icon and outlined Δ badge of a major deviation (confirmation required), on deviation-major-bg and on surface-sunken.

deviation-major-border.$description: Badge and cell border of a major deviation (confirmation required).

no-reference-bg.$description: Cell background of a no reference (new at this terminal); its border is dashed. Text on it: text-primary, text-secondary.

no-reference-fg.$description: Icon and outlined Δ badge of a no reference (new at this terminal); its border is dashed, on no-reference-bg and on surface-sunken.

no-reference-border.$description: Badge and cell border of a no reference (new at this terminal); its border is dashed.

deviation-major-badge-bg.$description: Fill of the filled Δ badge of a major deviation (badge weight separates major from minor).

deviation-major-badge-fg.$description: Numerals and icon inside the filled major Δ badge.

reference-outdated-fg.$description: Icon and label of the reference-outdated modifier. No background of its own.

needs-confirmation-fg.$description: Row marker and F8 jump targets of fields that block release.

overlay-stroke-dark.$description: Dark half of the double stroke around source highlights, crop handles and redaction boxes on screenshots. Same in every theme so it reads on any imagery.

overlay-stroke-light.$description: Light half of the double stroke on screenshots; also the crop-handle fill.

redaction-fill.$description: Opaque fill of redaction boxes over screenshots. Label on it: overlay-stroke-light.

env-test-fg.$description: TEST indicator text and icon. Outside the critical family by rule.

shadow-popover.$description: Menus, combobox lists, tooltips. Single layer, zero spread.

shadow-dialog.$description: Dialog windows. Single layer, zero spread.

shadow-glow-focal.$description: Optional glow on the single focal panel only. Never counted towards contrast or focus visibility.

light.$description: Colour and shadow tokens of the light theme, converted from Claude Design system Tallyline, version 1791542897-a5d3.

deviation-minor-bg.$description: Cell background of a minor deviation ("please cross-check"). Text on it: text-primary, text-secondary.

deviation-minor-fg.$description: Icon and outlined Δ badge of a minor deviation ("please cross-check"), on deviation-minor-bg and on surface-sunken.

deviation-minor-border.$description: Badge and cell border of a minor deviation ("please cross-check").

deviation-major-bg.$description: Cell background of a major deviation (confirmation required). Text on it: text-primary, text-secondary.

deviation-major-fg.$description: Icon and outlined Δ badge of a major deviation (confirmation required), on deviation-major-bg and on surface-sunken.

deviation-major-border.$description: Badge and cell border of a major deviation (confirmation required).

no-reference-bg.$description: Cell background of a no reference (new at this terminal); its border is dashed. Text on it: text-primary, text-secondary.

no-reference-fg.$description: Icon and outlined Δ badge of a no reference (new at this terminal); its border is dashed, on no-reference-bg and on surface-sunken.

no-reference-border.$description: Badge and cell border of a no reference (new at this terminal); its border is dashed.

deviation-major-badge-bg.$description: Fill of the filled Δ badge of a major deviation (badge weight separates major from minor).

deviation-major-badge-fg.$description: Numerals and icon inside the filled major Δ badge.

reference-outdated-fg.$description: Icon and label of the reference-outdated modifier. No background of its own.

needs-confirmation-fg.$description: Row marker and F8 jump targets of fields that block release.

overlay-stroke-dark.$description: Dark half of the double stroke around source highlights, crop handles and redaction boxes on screenshots. Same in every theme so it reads on any imagery.

overlay-stroke-light.$description: Light half of the double stroke on screenshots; also the crop-handle fill.

redaction-fill.$description: Opaque fill of redaction boxes over screenshots. Label on it: overlay-stroke-light.

env-test-fg.$description: TEST indicator text and icon. Outside the critical family by rule.

shadow-popover.$description: Menus, combobox lists, tooltips. Single layer, zero spread.

shadow-dialog.$description: Dialog windows. Single layer, zero spread.

shadow-glow-focal.$description: Optional glow on the single focal panel only. Never counted towards contrast or focus visibility.
